target_policy: Development labels only; no holdout scoring. Full train labels used only for final fit.
context_policy: Transductive unlabeled full train+test roster: group size, peer attributes, unanimous imputation. No target propagation.
gate: Screen accuracy >0.83 and improvement >=0.001; both new split seeds improve; confirmation mean accuracy >0.83 and mean gain >=0.001. Candidate frozen before confirmation. User approval required before online submission.
conditional_expert_policy: Global model exactly v34: v6 Cat on observed-only spend contrasts plus the existing spatial spline. Known CryoSleep states receive fixed .5 global/.5 state expert probabilities; unknown stays global. Each expert uses identical contrast inputs and v6 Cat parameters. Within each outer training state subset, stratified20% validation selects iterations by Logloss with patience50/max700. A fresh model refits all state training rows for that count. No outer-validation label access. Global spline contribution is diluted from .5 to .25 on its eligible slice.
